limitations: This is an online information-set search around the validated A4 rollout policy, not an exact solution of the full extensive-form game.
The runtime comparison contains 40 games per configuration and is a performance regression test, not a narrow confidence interval proof.
Rotating benchmark opponents are one-step policies; a full-search-versus-full-search tournament would require substantially more computation.
The rejected multi-policy result is retained to prevent the unsupported assumption that more opponent models automatically produce a stronger general strategy.
